title: Two ways to detect view mode: insightMode vs regex isInViewMode
answers: Is there another view-mode check besides insightMode?
body: insightLogic.tsx `isInViewMode` (~L977) is a regex on router pathname (`/insights/[a-zA-Z0-9]+$`) and does not read insightSceneLogic's `insightMode`. The two can disagree (e.g. subscriptions/alerts/sharing sub-paths, or new). Prefer `insightMode` in scene-level UI; be aware which one a component uses.
applies: Components using insightLogic selectors vs insightSceneLogic; not for embedded/dashboard tiles where no scene exists.
